item.title: Version 1.5.60
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.60 Update

  • 💄 Compact Accessibility Status
    - Replaced the large Accessibility card in General settings with a compact permission icon beside Trigger Shortcut.
    - A green check shows permission is granted; a red warning icon opens Accessibility settings when clicked.
  • 🎨 System Icon Rendering
    - Removed duplicate runtime padding and adopted the native macOS app icon format, so OnText now fills its icon area correctly in Activity Monitor and Accessibility settings.
